description: With a low-profile cushion and grippy recycled backing, the Trailhead Pet Mat makes a calm statement in a kitchen or entryway where everyday paws tend to land. A relaxed contemporary and easy transitional sensibility informs the proportions, while gray and blue tones combine easily with pieces you already own. Durable polyester fibers and recycled polyester fibers add structure and warmth. Washable cover simplifies fresh-up routines; non-slip backing helps the mat stay put. The design balances visual softness with practical construction for a real home.
assembly: No assembly required. Unroll or unfold the mat on a clean, dry, level surface.
care: Shake out loose debris and machine wash cold with mild detergent. Air dry or tumble dry low; avoid fabric softener.
